title: Home Run Apt w/ Balcony Downtown Nashville
description:
Enjoy Autumn in Stylish Top-Floor Downtown Nashville Apt w/Gated Garage & dedicated parking. Easy Walk to Broadway! This space offers comfort, style, & a perfect home base for exploring & staying in Music City. Thoughtfully decorated with modern finishes, it’s ideal for guests who want to be close to the action while relaxing in a clean, elevated space. Offering 1 bedroom/1 bath, fully stocked kitchen with all amenities. Walkable to restaurants, live music, & nightlife! Perfect for Temp Housing!

The space
Bliss Road Offers 5 Star Properties,
Fully Furnished with all Amenities,
High End Towels/Linens/ and Bedding.

Every home has a starter kit stocked with paper products, including paper towels and toilet paper, as well as coffee supplies!

Guest access
The whole house is available for your relaxing pleasure whether inside or out. Enjoy various spaces through-out, for much needed peace and quiet. Keys will be provided for entry.

Guests can enjoy whole house, and it is reserved for paid overnight guests only.

Other things to note
Only registered guests are allowed on property.

OPEN FOR: Temp Housing Agencies & Insurance Companies. Offering special rates for Insurance & Temp Housing Needs w/ Short & Mid-Term Stays.
